main_text.p: 3 Porrò Selophead filio Hepher, filii Gilead, filii Machir, filii Manasse nō fuerunt filii, sed filiæ: quarum ista sunt nomina, Mahala, & Noa, Hogla, Milcha, & Thirsa.

4 Hę accesserunt in conspectum Eleazar sacerdotis, & in cōspectum Iosue filii Nun, atque in conspectu principum, dicendo, Iehoua præcepit Mosi vt daret nobis hereditate in medio fratrum nostrorū. Itaque dedit eis iuxta sermonem Iehouæ, hereditatem in medio fratrum patris earum.
5 Et ceciderunt hereditates Manasse decem, præter terram Gilead & Basan, quæ erant trans Iordanem.
6 Filiæ enim Manasse sortitæ sunt hereditatem in medio filiorum eius: terra autem Gilead fuit filiis Manasse reliquis.
7 Fuit autem terminus Manasse ab Aser ad Michmethath, quæ est coram Sechem,

page.notes: Handwritten marginal and interlinear annotations in ink (above the first line, in the left margin, and "no sunt filii" above line 3) are manuscript additions and are not transcribed. The word "Selophead" in line 3 is underlined in manuscript. The word "Sechem," at the foot is a catchword. Some letters are faint due to show-through.
